caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bonnet, rendered in shades of brown. The main body of the bonnet is rounded and extends outward with a slightly curved rectangular shape, showing a quilted pattern with horizontal lines. Attached to the lower edge is a loose, gathered portion of fabric that extends outward, providing extra coverage or decoration. Two long, similarly colored ribbons hang down from the bottom center of the bonnet, intended for tying under the chin. The overall composition presents the bonnet centered on a light, plain background, with no additional objects or embellishments present.
title: Rain Bonnet
